description: Factory-built protected1S high-rate LiPo pack for the EVT1 flange
status: Defined for RFQ; supplier acceptance and received-pack validation pending
reference_limit: A25357 lists1A continuous/2A peak. It is a size/construction reference, not an accepted substitute for this1.5A continuous request.

protection_requirements.overcurrent_and_short: Supplier must provide thresholds, delays, FET loss/temperature, recovery behavior and evidence supporting the requested continuous/pulse load. Do not derive protection-trip values from the cell10C headline.
protection_requirements.charge_recovery: Recover from permitted undervoltage protection by applying4.2V-limited charger to the two protected output leads; provide the exact recovery conditions.

growth_note: CAD reserves1.1mm extra thickness (about20.8percent of the reference5.3mm cell thickness) and0.25mm lateral clearance per side. This is an engineering allowance, not a manufacturer swelling guarantee. Supplier must approve containment/support and end-of-life limits; a larger requirement needs another package review. Pack front moves0.3mm rearward to preserve a0.95mm nominal passage behind the rear stub for thin sensor wiring.

lead_exit.product_end: NegativeX short end, PCM toward the central neck
lead_exit.conductors: Two AWG28 stranded copper leads with insulation OD0.50..0.63mm, factory terminated; supplier must verify1.5A continuous/2A100ms and its thermal/drop budget for the finished pack/lead/connector assembly.
lead_exit.free_wire_route: 1mm straight toward-X, then4mm centreline bend toward-Z, then1mm straight into the socket housing.8.283mm nominal exposed insulated path from pack case to housing wire-exit plane; supplier to set cut/strip length from actual crimp datum. Do not substitute a12mm cut-wire assumption.
lead_exit.connector_frame: Long mating axisZ, two wire centers alongY. Pack socket wires enter from+Z:pin1 at(2,-17.7,2.5),pin2 at(2,-18.9,2.5). Body plug enters from-Z. Verify marked circuit numbers/continuity; do not mirror a drawing by eye.
lead_exit.required_drawing: Supplier to confirm exact pack short-end exit locations, lead strain relief, finished maximum and formed connector/lead envelope. The standard100mm tinned26AWG lead is a construction reference, not the requested EVT termination.
lead_exit.assembly_reason: The cap/body-PCB module must thread with free flange tails. The battery is connected afterward inside the open flange; it cannot remain tethered while that module rotates.

external_thermistors.mount: Tape-couple both insulated heads to separate locations on the pack broad face. Keep them dry inside the closed rigid cavity; never directly overmold, immerse or hard-pot them.
external_thermistors.return_wiring: Six physical pack-module conductors: protectedP+/P-, TS1/TS1-return, TS2/TS2-return. Solder both sensor returns to bodyJ2's sensor-return land2S and power return to2P; join returns only on the body PCB.
external_thermistors.lead_exit_orientation: Orient the free factory leads toward+X at the27mm end of each head/transition envelope. Shorten and extend with separately insulated32AWG pigtails in the open assembly; keep separate returns until bodyJ2.

assembly_and_service.cell_work: Cell tab welding/PCM assembly and factory ACH socket crimping belong to the battery supplier. Installer solders only insulated external sensor leads and existing protected interconnects; do not crimp the wrong wire range or expose bare cell tabs.
assembly_and_service.molding: Install only after inert closed-cavity/process trials pass. Keep pack and external NTCs isolated from silicone/resin and within their temperature/pressure limits. No pressure-pot process is specified for a battery assembly.
assembly_and_service.service: EVT workshop service consumes the continuous silicone skin: remove/recast the skin to open both plastic halves, unplug the protected power connector and rework four separately insulated sensor-extension joints. No exposed service lid and no battery path through the12mm neck. Practice removal on an inert assembly first.

load_budget.calculation: (3.4*(0.4+0.025)+3.82*0.45)/(3.0*0.8)=1.3183A;1.5A continuous request adds about13.8percent margin. These are design budgets, not measured maxima or a guaranteed efficiency bound.
load_budget.required_EVT_tests: Measure radio+motor running/startup current, rail regulation/droop, pack/FET heat, cutoff/recovery and inrush before enabling motor operation on a pack. Stall/fault loads must not be treated as normal continuous demand.24-hour endurance is a measured duty-profile target, not inferred from capacity.
